detailZones.title: Arrivals channels
detailZones.description: Follow the green and red floor routes, overhead lane signals, glass partitions and channel entrance fittings.

detailZones.title: Baggage screening conveyor
detailZones.description: Inspect the X-ray tunnel, conveyor rollers, belt, trays, return track and screening-machine housing.

detailZones.title: Inspection desks
detailZones.description: Explore the inspection counter, desk panels, trays, document surfaces, monitor stands and visitor-facing barrier.

detailZones.title: Trolleys and luggage
detailZones.description: Identify the nested luggage trolleys, handles, baskets, wheels, suitcases and trolley bay fittings.

detailZones.title: Arrivals exit and glazing
detailZones.description: Inspect the arrival exit doors, glass panels, door rails, security cameras, clock, windows and seating.

detailZones.title: Queue and hall fittings
detailZones.description: Explore the queue posts, ceiling fixtures, glass partitions, side desk, wall panels and open circulation space.

anchorAudit.rationale: The generated source and final JPEG were inspected at native and final pixels. This scene retains 150 independently pointable objects and visible parts across 6 bounded zones. People, identity, readable text, brands, hidden contents, inferred processes and unsupported states were excluded.
